latin: Qui negat coelum esse animatum, ita ut motor eius non sit forma eius, non solum Aristoteli repugnat, sed totius philosophiae fundamenta destruit. u
translation: Whoever denies that the heaven is animate, in such a way that its mover is not its form, not only contradicts Aristotle but overturns the foundations of the whole of philosophy.
